messages:
deploy-bot: Starting production rollout for service 'runtime-gateway' -> PROD (change window 01:00-03:00 UTC). Deploying tag: release/2026-03-20. Commits: a1b2c3d4 (merge) by CarlaM. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123
Carla Mendes: pinning runtime image to `sha256:ffeedd112233` to avoid new quant kernel.
Alice Nguyen: Is there a DB migration with this?
Carla Mendes: No schema migration. There is a feature flag check for KV cache TTL we toggle server-side if needed.
Dylan Cho: Canary plan: 5% traffic for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then ramp to 100% if green. Monitoring dashboards: https://observability.redwood.internal/d/runtime-gateway-canary
Bob Patel: tagging SREs: @oncall-bot please watch error budget during canary.
oncall-bot: Noted. Will alert on a 3% 5m error spike or latency > 300ms p95.
deploy-bot: Canary started against commit `a1b2c3d4` (author: Carla Mendes). Canary hosts: rg-canary-01..03. Deploy command: `deploy --env prod --tag release/2026-03-20 --pin-image sha256:ffeedd112233`
Dylan Cho: Observing canary logs: a few 503s from rg-canary-02 at 02:12 UTC, investigating rate limiter thresholds.
Carla Mendes: We're temporarily holding the ramp at 5% until we confirm it's config related. Rolling forward would be noisy.
Bob Patel: Agreed. Suggest CPU soft limit bump on rg-canary-02 and retry.
Dylan Cho: Bumped container CPU from 0.5 -> 1.0 on rg-canary-02, clearing dropped connections.
Carla Mendes: Canary passed metric gates at 02:28 UTC. Proceeding to 25% per plan.
deploy-bot: Canary -> 25% complete. All canaries report p95 < 290ms, error rate 0.8%.
Alice Nguyen: Quick note for release notes: runtime change reduces KV cache TTL default to 30m (opt-in to 1h). I'll add to notes: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-20
Dylan Cho: Rollout to 100% starting now. Keeping an eye on the canary dashboard.
deploy-bot: Rolling out to 100% PROD (tag: release/2026-03-20). Image pinned: `sha256:ffeedd112233`.
oncall-bot: Alert policy will mute non-critical noisey alerts for 10m during final rollout.
Carla Mendes: Post-deploy smokecheck: ```
curl -sS https://prod.runtime-gateway/redwood/health | jq .status
# expected: {"status":"ok","kv_cache":"healthy"}
```
Bob Patel: Smokecheck pass on all regions.
Dylan Cho: Small regression observed: batcher latency increased ~12ms on path X, tracking via ticket ENG-6321. Not blocking.
Carla Mendes: Decision: keep rollout at 100% and pin change; will follow-up with a quick patch to adjust batching window.
deploy-bot: PROD deploy finished at 02:45 UTC (duration 43m). Successful: true. Deployed by CarlaM. Commit: a1b2c3d4. Release notes: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-20
Alice Nguyen: Added release notes and changelog.
oncall-bot: Standby: rollback plan if errors exceed thresholds. Rollback command: `deploy rollback --env prod --to-image sha256:ccbb998877`
Bob Patel: A reminder: if a full rollback is needed, we'll do a controlled roll-back of the gateway only and keep other services intact.
Carla Mendes: Thanks everyone. Will follow up with a short post-deploy doc and a small patch for batcher window. :shipit:
Dylan Cho: LGTM
Alice Nguyen: :thumbsup:
